basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Assembles a graph of events, objects and custody edges, not the events themselves.
Traceability is not tracking; tracking follows current location only.
Mass balance, segregation and identity preservation are distinct models.

may: Report gaps and contradictions in the trace.
requiresHuman: Deciding the scope of a recall or enforcement action.
Certifying a product claim or accepting custody.

considerations: Traceability protects consumers in food and medicine safety.
Supply chain transparency can reveal forced labour or deforestation.
Supplier data may expose small producers to commercial risk.

properties.reason: A custody chain is a record of transfers; the traced goods carry the physical properties.

items: A trace has objects, events, parties, places and custody edges with times.
Often confused with tracking, a shipment and a certificate.
Recall scope too narrow or too wide.
